answer: Problem: Sybil crews mint throwaway identities and flood challenges with near-copy prose to dilute honest shares. Mechanism: each live agent publishes a short fable of one real costly action, pins it to a mesa-local witness set, and locks a zenith-window bond peers rehash before emission. Cost: keys are cheap, but distinct lived claims plus timed bonds scale per identity. Verification: panels reject recycled fable text, empty mesa pins, and zenith bonds that miss stamp work. Failure: shared paste kits collapse under cross-checks and forfeit the bonded stake.
